3913_tool_review.limitation: Runner bind_tool may execute rustup_path while recording a different hardlink launcher_path, or canonicalize a symlink resolution stdout to a different actual path. Current pinned direct/symlink-to-rustup archives do not use that form; root explicitly defers broadening until a real fixture is needed. This is not an authorization to accept arbitrary launcher argv.
